data.animaCaption: Three cinematic panels follow Shiki Natsume through a single covert operation—passing a secret note in a wine velvet gown, parting safehouse blinds in a black trench coat, and catching her breath in a rain-streaked getaway sedan.
data.promptProse: Left panel: In a dim amber jazz lounge, Shiki Natsume wears a plunging wine-red backless velvet gown and black opera gloves, glancing coolly over her bare shoulder beside a crystal whiskey glass; Middle panel: Inside a pitch-dark safehouse sliced by cyan neon venetian blind stripes, she wears a matte-black belted trench coat, her left hand parting one blind slat with two fingers while her right index finger presses lightly to her lips; Right panel: In the cramped leather backseat of a rain-pounded black getaway car streaked with red and blue night lights, she wears a half-unzipped black cropped leather jacket showing her collarbone, glancing sideways with flushed intensity.
data.story: 三格电影级竖屏分镜浓缩一整夜的秘密行动：左格酒廊露背红裙暗渡情报，中格安全屋冷蓝百叶窗后噤声警戒，右格暴雨撤离车厢内半拉皮衣微喘回眸。
